problems: Old program (dept founded 2006) lost ACGME accreditation c.2019-20; last graduate June 2020; no residents 2020-22; new program accredited 2022-04-01 (1/yr, 7 yrs). 2017-18..2019-20 unobservable (no roster on any archived host, Wayback or CC), so the wind-down transfers-out (Vidalis, Voronovich, Harris, Starling, Green) and graduations are unobserved. Common Crawl failures (listed for phase 2 retry): CC-MAIN-2012 edu,unm,neurosurgery)/; 2015-11 edu,unm,neurosurgery)/; 2016-18 hsc som; 2017-26 hsc medicine; 2018-09 hsc som + hsc medicine; 2018-47 hsc medicine; 2019-47 hsc som; 2021-43 hsc medicine; 2023-06 hsc medicine. PGY inconsistencies: Gahramanov Program Year 1 in 2014-15 but 4th year in 2015-16 (entry 2014 vs 2012); Kazim PGY1 2022-23 but PGY4 in both 2024-25 and 2025-26; Rumalla (Barrow PGY-2 2022-23) is UNM PGY3 in 2024-25 (entry by arithmetic 2022). Old-program chiefs finished at listed PGY-6 (6-yr track for pre-2013 entrants; ACGME 7-yr from 2013), so adjudicator marks Ramirez/Sanchez 'LEFT' at PGY-6. Two PGY-1s in 2014 (three), 2015, 2024 and 2026 despite stated 1/yr complement. Pre-2011 entrants Kristen Upchurch and Andrew Lyons (2010-11 list only, not in 2012-13) not loaded. training_history: inserted Pappu (2012) and Chohan (2014) graduation rows from program documents (annual report, history page). PHASE 2: CC-MAIN-2020-34 abqjournal index range failed. Adjudicator labels Kazim 'SWITCHED SPECIALTY' from NPI only; training_history records departure_type unknown.
terminal_pgy_note: Pre-2013 entrants trained 6 years (Pappu 2012, Chohan 2014, Ramirez 2015, Sanchez 2017 graduated at PGY-6); 2013+ entrants 7 years (Akbik, Mohammad PGY-7 June 2020).

accreditation.circumstances: ACGME Office of Complaints letter Aug 2018 (7 allegations: falling caseload, residents pulled from OR for service tasks, retaliation, chair threatening dismissal, no pediatric/spine/functional faculty); program on probation; summer-2019 site visit; withdrawal notified Aug 2019, effective 2020-06-30. Chair post vacant ~5 months; Meic Schmidt hired (started Feb 2020). 10 residents in 2019-20: 2 finished June 2020, 8 (1-6 years left) had to transfer, UNM paying their salaries at the new programs.
sources: Albuquerque Journal 2019-10-17 'UNM med school to lose residency program' (abqjournal.com/1379907, Common Crawl CC-MAIN-2019-47 and 2020-24; saved data/raw/extraction/p97/phase2/abqjournal_1379907_cc201947.html)
